content_sections.text: The notification is issued by the Department for Empowerment of Persons with Disabilities, Senior Citizens & Transgender Persons, Hyderabad District, under the Government of Telangana. content_sections.heading: Hyderabad PwD Backlog Vacancy 2026
content_sections.text: The notification announces 83 backlog posts reserved for Persons with Benchmark Disabilities (PwBD): 3 Group-IV posts and 80 Class-IV posts. The notice states that these are approximate numbers and that the vacancies are subject to decrease or increase according to the circumstances.

content_sections.heading: Hyderabad PwD Backlog Category-wise Vacancy 2026
content_sections.text: Every post is reserved for persons with disabilities. The notice splits each post by disability category: VI (Visually Impaired), HI (Hearing Impaired), LD (Locomotor Disability) and ID (Intellectual Disabilities). A dash in the notice is shown as 0. The 4% reservation for PwDs is distributed 1% each for VI, HI, LD and ID under section 34(1) of the RPwD Act, 2016 (G.O.Ms.No.10 WCD & SC, dated 30.08.2018). Selection follows horizontal reservation for PwDs (G.O.Ms.No.35 GAD (SER-D), dated 13.02.2014 and G.O.Ms.No.3 DW, WCD, SC & TGP, dated 10.02.2024), the Telangana Last Grade Service Rules, 1992 and the Telangana State & Subordinate Service Rules, 1996. 33 1/3% reservation for women with disabilities is applied horizontally. If eligible women candidates of VI(W), HI(W), LD(W) or ID(W) are not available, the post is filled by eligible male candidates with the same category of disability, so eligible male candidates of VI, HI, LD and ID may apply. If eligible candidates of a particular disability category are not available, the post is filled by interchanging among PwD categories (carry forward and interchangeability under section 34(2) of the RPwD Act).

A disability certificate issued by the competent authority as per G.O.Ms.No.31, WD, CW & DW (DW) Department, dated 01.12.2009. Candidates must have a minimum of 40% degree of disability. Hearing impaired candidates are eligible only when their disability is 75% and above. Candidates holding a Temporary Disability certificate are not eligible for either Group-IV or Class-IV posts (G.O. Ms. No. 41 W.C.D & S.C (DW), dated 31.12.2022). Locomotor Disability (LD) covers orthopedically handicapped, leprosy cured persons, cerebral palsy, dwarfism, muscular dystrophy and acid attack victims with benchmark disability certificates. Intellectual Disabilities (ID) covers specific learning disability, intellectual disability, autism, mental illness and multiple disability, based on the degree of disability. All Group-IV and Class-IV posts are declared Local Cadre and notified as Hyderabad local posts only; non-local candidates are not eligible to apply. For posts with a minimum educational qualification, a candidate is local if he or she studied in the local area for at least four consecutive academic years ending with the year of the qualifying examination, or, if not studying, resided there for at least four years before that examination. For posts with no minimum educational qualification, a candidate is local if he or she resided in the local area for at least four years immediately preceding the notification date. To claim local status, candidates should submit study certificates of 1st to 7th class (G.O. Ms. No. 124, General Administration (SPF-F), dated 30.08.2018). For posts with a read and write qualification, candidates should submit a residence certificate from the concerned Tahsildar to claim local status. For visually impaired and hearing impaired persons who studied in special schools meant for them, the native place of their parents is treated as local (G.O.Ms.No.104, General Administration (SPF-A) Dept, dated 24.03.2000). Candidates serving in a government department may also apply through proper channel (from the employer) as per rules in force. For the full wording of each post's qualification, candidates should check the official notification.

content_sections.heading: Hyderabad PwD Backlog Selection Process 2026
content_sections.text: The two groups of posts are selected in different ways. For Junior Assistant, the written examination and oral interview are waived. Selection is made on the highest marks secured in the relevant degree (qualifying academic examination) along with usage of computers (G.O.Ms.No.74, General Administration (Services-A) Department, dated 14.02.2007). The District Selection Committee will conduct a test in "proficiency in Office Automation with usage of computer and associated software" to select meritorious candidates (G.O.Ms.No.133 & 135 GAD (SER-B), dated 12.05.2014). Selection is based on parameters fixed by the Task Force Committee / District Selection Committee, out of an aggregate of 50 marks. No marks are given for the prescribed or basic academic qualification, but that qualification is mandatory. If candidates get equal aggregate marks, the candidate with the higher degree of disability is preferred (G.O. Ms.No. 56 WD, CW & DW Dept, dated 02.12.2002). If the parameters are still equal, the elder candidate is preferred. The genuineness of medical certificates will be verified; doubtful cases go to the Appellate Medical Board, whose decision is final.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in Hyderabad PwD Backlog Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 83 backlog posts: 3 Junior Assistant (Group-IV) posts and 80 Class-IV posts. The notice calls these approximate numbers.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: Applications must be submitted up to 2 December 2026 at 5.00 PM at the Assistant Director's office in Nampally, Hyderabad.

faq.question: Q3. Who can apply for these posts?
faq.answer: Only Hyderabad local persons with benchmark disabilities (VI, HI, LD or ID) with at least 40% disability can apply. Hearing impaired candidates need 75% or more.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit?
faq.answer: Candidates should have completed 18 years and should not have completed 54 years of age as on 01.07.2026.

faq.question: Q5. What is the qualification for Junior Assistant and Office Subordinate?
faq.answer: Junior Assistant needs a degree with proficiency in Office Automation with usage of computer. Office Subordinate needs a pass in VII class.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary for these posts?
faq.answer: PRC, 2020 Scales are applicable to the respective posts.

faq.question: Q7. How are Class-IV candidates selected?
faq.answer: Class-IV candidates are selected on 50 marks: 15 for age, 30 for disability and 5 for multiple disability. Ties go to the higher degree of disability, then to the elder candidate.

faq.question: Q8. Is there a written exam for Junior Assistant?
faq.answer: No, the written examination and oral interview are waived. Selection is on degree marks, and the District Selection Committee will conduct a test in proficiency in Office Automation.

faq.question: Q9. Can I apply for more than one post?
faq.answer: Yes, but you must submit a separate application for each post with all the required documents.

faq.question: Q10. Can non-local candidates apply?
faq.answer: No. All posts are Hyderabad local posts and non-local candidates are not eligible to apply.
